verdict.rationale: Mercury's bill pay flow lets users upload/email bills which AI reads and auto-populates (mercury-docs-3), and payments support optional approval controls via org approval policies and 'Gate Disbursements' for manual review/sign-off before funds release (mercury-docs-47, mercury-docs-53, mercury-docs-55), backed by granular permissions (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-11). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the end-to-end bill-to-approval-to-payment workflow and more detail on multi-step approver configuration.
